# Ink runtime

`ink.js` is the unmodified runtime from npm package `inkjs@2.4.0`, `dist/ink.js`. Its MIT license is retained in `INKJS-LICENSE.md`. Upstream: https://github.com/y-lohse/inkjs. No CDN is used at runtime. The Yellow Door workflow also pins inkjs 2.4.0; this demo has its own original Ink source.
